summary: First-run comprehensive test. Backend: 36/36 tests passed (1 skipped). All critical flows validated: register (password mismatch/dup email/invalid referral/terms), login w/ 429 lockout after 5 failures, logout/logout-all/refresh/me, forgot-password + outbox + reset-password, 2FA setup/enable/login via pyotp, plan enrollment debit + idem_key dedupe, deposit reference regex + evidence folder enforcement, withdrawals/info + insufficient balance rejection, team summary generations (demo.b [1,1,1,1,0]), team members PII hidden, commission-sim math (Diamond x5 = 96500 minor; Diamond..Bronze = 70500 minor = 705.00), permission 401/403 across 7 admin endpoints, reconciliation consistent=true, liability report, campaign link normalization (inv.com -> https://inv.com) + HTML strip + bad link rejection + scheduled status, bulk suspend with confirm + login 403 + reactivate, idempotent simulation.run, Bronze user team-message send. Frontend: homepage, /login, /app (user dashboard with charts & stats), /admin (overview with metrics & alerts) all render with full data-testid coverage. Both user & admin logins work end-to-end.

minor.issue: javascript:alert(1) link returns 422 (pydantic) rather than 400 from safe_url — functionally equivalent (both reject) but the review spec expected 400. The 422 appears to come from channels validation; safe_url is never reached because `javascript:alert(1)` fails the pydantic str validation path for the audience when combined with 'all'. Actual mechanism unclear but rejection works.

issues: Console hydration warning: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' — React hydration error flagged, may stem from a select/option element rendering a span icon. Non-blocking but should be fixed to avoid SSR/hydration mismatches.

action_items: Fix hydration warning: <span> inside <option> in a select component (likely in PublicLayout header or a form select). Replace with text-only option or use a custom dropdown.
Consider: 10-register-per-hour rate limit per IP is quite strict for testing — testing agents must clear db.rate_limits between runs. Not a bug, just a note.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_admin.py line 553-555: __import__('core').rank_for(...) — ugly, prefer top-level `from core import rank_for` (it is already imported higher via `from core import ... recompute_rank` so just add rank_for).
routes_auth.py line 170-172 logout: cookies are deleted but with same options (samesite='none', secure=True) — good. However login_attempts counter is not cleared on logout — minor.

jobs.py acquire_lock has a race: find_one_and_update with upsert on a condition that may not match an existing locked row will raise DuplicateKeyError (caught) — fine, but the condition {'$or':[{'until':{'$lt': iso()}}, {'until': None}]} on upsert does not include name match, which is fine because unique index on name forces single doc; still would be clearer to check expiry explicitly.

core.py post_ledger: uses `-amount + reserved_delta > 0` to require sufficient available balance, but reserved_delta is used only for withdrawals (both ledger and reserve updated atomically) — logic is correct but very dense; add comment.
routes_user.py mask_name: for single-word names returns 'M****' etc. Correct, but when gen==1 returns full name — ok.
routes_user.py line 406-407: destination format validation uses re.match without ^$ anchors on $ side — re.match anchors start only; could allow trailing garbage. Should use re.fullmatch or anchor $.

routes_admin.py withdraw action completed/rejected: `release` not called when action=='completed' (uses reserved_delta=-amount in post_ledger). But when rejected after 'approved' or 'processing', the open_lock gets unset but reserve was already released? Actually in approved/processing state the reservation is still live and only released on reject. Looks correct.
server.py: no graceful handling of CORS_ORIGINS missing. OK since .env has it.
All endpoints use /api prefix properly; MongoDB _id consistently excluded via {_id:0}.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of core flows tested (home, login, user dashboard, admin dashboard)

Public homepage header has a hydration warning (span inside option) worth checking in a select component.
rca of the issue: No critical issues found. Minor hydration warning: likely a select element renders a child <span> inside its <option>, which is invalid HTML. Reproduction: open any page, check browser console. Mitigation: locate the component (search for `<option>` and `<span>` co-location in /app/frontend/src) and replace with icon-less text or move the icon outside the <select>.
